# ui::Symmetric

Header: `winui/core/Geometry.hpp`.

A [ui::Thickness](thickness.md) with one value on the left and right and another on the top and bottom: `.padding = ui::Symmetric{.horizontal = 16, .vertical = 8}`.

Converts to a [Thickness](thickness.md) wherever one is taken.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `horizontal` | `float` | `0.0f` | The left and the right edge, DIPs. |
| `vertical` | `float` | `0.0f` | The top and the bottom edge, DIPs. |
